notes.status: Room 1 only. Staged, not playable — no enemies exist yet, so the room declares how many face the player and the screen draws that many placeholders.
notes.id: A v4 UUID, like cards (SCHEMA.md §2). The map references rooms by it; `number` is for display and ordering, never for lookup.
notes.enemies: Who stands across the table. Provisional: an entry names its art under assets/enemies/ and carries its own maxHealth, because data/enemies.json is still unpopulated and there is no enemy entity to point at. maxHealth here is a placeholder — SCHEMA.md §7 has enemy health as deliberately unchosen and it has not been balanced against anything. It becomes a list of enemy ids once there are enemies.
notes.background: Resolved through the same filename lookup as card and pet art — assets/backgrounds/.
notes.rooms: Seven, one for each node after the map's START. START marks where the player begins and is not a room, so rooms[i] is the map's nodes[i + 1]. Only Room 1 is built: the rest carry an id, a number and a name and nothing else.
notes.map: The run's route. Its sibling .json names where each node sits on the parchment, normalised, so nodes[i] is rooms[i] — the circles and the dotted line between them are painted into the art, not drawn by the screen.
notes.icon: What sits on the room's circle on the map. Optional — a room without one shows an empty marker. Resolved from assets/maps/ like the parchment itself.
notes.start: Where the player begins — the map's first node, the one the parchment labels START. It is a place, not a room: nothing is fought there and it is never entered, so it carries a name and an icon and nothing else.
